name: FGR4b
status: exploratory extension of FGR4 (disclosed amendment, 14 November 2026)
purpose: Rounding control and a finer delta for the FGR4 uncertainty ladder: the 16 FGR4 replicates reproduced every outcome and return time but moved the next coordinate by up to 2.6e-8 when a start sat in another batch position, too close to delta = 1e-8 for a 16-row control. Reruns all 466 bases inside M exactly (delta = 0) in new batch positions and adds delta = 1e-10.
storage: All full-state updates in immutable 128-update shards outside Git, copied, fsynced and rehashed on /archive before advancing (the FGR3 Evidence class). Never splice failed attempts.

zoom.base_rule: One uniform draw in each of 1024 equal strata of the domain.
zoom.interval_source: Complement of the two long resolved runs of the FGR3 table under the tau rule of tools/fold_return_unwrap.py (post-test diagnostic, 14 November 2026).
zoom.stop: First qualified natural departure, verified period-3 approach, other recurrence candidate, or 1024 updates, as in FGR3 training.
zoom.analysis: Uncertainty fraction p(delta) of the outcome under two criteria (return time; unwrapped departure time tau with tolerance 0.5 channel steps), exponent alpha from levels delta <= 1e-4 with at least 10 uncertain pairs, bootstrap over bases. Replicate batch must reproduce kind, time and next coordinate exactly.

claims: One prompt and parameter setting; departures reconstructed on the FGR2C curve. An exponent below one indicates structure at every sampled scale between 1e-8 and 1e-4 in q, not an infinite fractal. Rounding is about 1e-16 relative; the smallest delta is about 1e-10 relative to the state norm.
publication: Report, article and blog updates only after audit; no paid computation.
